text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 detected — elevated 5xx + timeout rate from `api-gateway` (us-east-1). Window start 2026-03-15T10:12:03Z. Affected route: POST /v1/generate. Current error: 502/504 spikes and gateway timeouts. Paging on-call: @suzanne. Incident page: https://incidents.redwood/p/INC-2026-0315-gateway-5xx
suzanne: Ack — I'm on it. Quick ask: any upstream service names or correlation IDs showing up in logs? Which customers reporting impact?
will: Seeing multiple customer errors for webhooks and direct API calls. Datadog latency/5xx graph: https://dd.ops/redwood/d/xyz. 5xx went from ~1% baseline to ~12% at peak. Most are for /v1/generate.
omar: Any deploys around that time? I checked releases; nothing matching 10:00-10:15.
will: No deploys. Traces show lots of `model-proxy` 504s returned to gateway. Also a big uptick in gateway->model-proxy retries.
alex-sre: Query I ran on logs (kubectl/elk):
```
# search last 30m for upstream timeouts
kail -l app=gateway --since 30m | grep -E "504|upstream_timeout|x-request-id"
```
Found sample lines with x-request-id and upstream error: 
```
{"ts":"2026-03-15T10:13:11Z","level":"error","msg":"upstream timeout","component":"gateway","route":"/v1/generate","x-request-id":"rid-0a1b2c3d","upstream":"model-proxy-1","retry_count":3}
{"ts":"2026-03-15T10:13:18Z","level":"error","msg":"gateway gave up after retries","component":"gateway","x-request-id":"rid-0f9e8d7c","status":504}
```
These show gateway retried at least 2-3 times then returned 504.
jia: Hypothesis: model-proxy latency spike + gateway retry policy produced retry amplification -> downstream queueing -> cascading timeouts. Need timeline correlation between model-proxy GC/CPU and gateway retries.
will: Honeycomb traces: long tail from model-proxy requests 200-800ms -> then sudden >2s for a subset. Many retries are queued on gateway causing head-of-line. Also saw a config of `max_retries: 4` for certain routes.
suzanne: Immediate mitigations proposed: 1) reduce gateway retry policy to 0 for /v1/generate, 2) scale model-proxy replicas + check OOM/GC, 3) enable circuit-breaker on gateway for repeated upstream failures, 4) temporarily route a fraction of traffic to healthy region (canary). I'll start 1 and 2 now.
omar: Applying retry override to 0 for route; command:
```
# api to update routing override
curl -X POST "$ROUTER_API/routes/override" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","max_retries":0}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
Scaling model-proxy pods now:
```
kubectl scale deployment/model-proxy --replicas=8 -n inference
```
Applying now, will paste events.
incident-bot: Deploybot: routing override applied by omar (ci-deploy-8923). Model-proxy scale started; rollout in progress.
suzanne: Observing early signal: 5xx rate down from 12% -> ~6% within ~90s of override. Keep monitoring.
dana-ml: Noted also increased memory usage on model-proxy causing full GC pauses at ~10:11-10:14 window; look for `heap_usage` spikes. If GC is causing long blocking, scaling helps but also check cache eviction.
will: Running traces to list representative correlation IDs we should include in RCA: `rid-0a1b2c3d`, `rid-0f9e8d7c`, `rid-01aa77bb`. Use those to pull full request logs and model-proxy logs.
alex-sre: Raw snippet from model-proxy log (stacked):
```
2026-03-15T10:13:10.912Z ERROR model-proxy request_timeout req_id=rid-0a1b2c3d backend=executor-7 latency=2003ms retries=1 reason="queue timeout"
2026-03-15T10:13:11.114Z WARN  model-proxy evict_cache item=ctx:abc123 evicted_by=memory_pressure
```
This matches memory pressure + queue timeouts.
jia: Timeline (quick, please add/correct):
- 10:12:03Z: Alerts triggered — gateway 5xx spike detected
- 10:12:30Z: model-proxy heap/GC metrics spike; latency increases
- 10:13:05Z: Gateway begins retrying failing upstreams (per logs)
- 10:13:20Z: 1st customer reports; correlation ids captured
- 10:16:00Z: omar applied retry override to 0
- 10:16:30Z: model-proxy scale started to 8 replicas
- 10:18:45Z: first drop in 5xx observed; stabilizing by 10:22Z
suzanne: Good timeline. Alex, can you add the full log slices to the incident storage? Put queries we used.
alex-sre: Pushed logs and links to incident page: https://incidents.redwood/p/INC-2026-0315-gateway-5xx/logs. Saved queries: `service:model-proxy AND req_id:rid-*` and `component:gateway AND route:/v1/generate AND status:5*`.
will: Action items in-thread:
- omar: RCA lead (investigate root cause: memory pressure + retry amplification)
- jia: customer comms + summary for affected customers (who saw 504)
- alex-sre: attach log exports & timeline to postmortem
- dana-ml: investigate cache eviction behavior and model-proxy memory tuning
- will: produce metric snapshots (5xx%, p95/p99 latency pre/post)
suzanne: Handoff to omar at 10:30Z — I'm going to step out for a short scheduled call but will rejoin for postmortem. Please escalate if degradation reappears. @omar take lead. :thumbsup:
omar: Taking ownership. I'll dig into scheduler settings and evictions, and confirm if retry config + GC caused it. First step: collect heap dumps from affected pods and check model load distribution. Will also correlate request IDs across gateway->model-proxy->executor.
suzanne: Thanks. Noted that customer impact window ~10:12-10:22Z. We'll prepare initial customer note once jia drafts. Add any new observations here so the postmortem has primary evidence: logs, traces, heap metrics, and exact config values for `max_retries` and `retry_backoff`.
jia: Drafting a short customer note, will share in #customer-success channel then post link here.
omar: Quick early hypothesis summary to put in postmortem: "root cause likely combination of model-proxy memory pressure (causing GC pauses and increased latency) and gateway retry policy that amplified transient failures into broader timeouts. Mitigation: disabled retries, scaled replicas, and queued follow-ups to tune cache and memory limits."
suzanne: Good. I'll mark this thread as active incident and we can transition to a postmortem doc after stabilization. Closing handover — last message from me.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=stabilized, lead=omar, severity=P1 -> monitoring. Postmortem skeleton: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/INC-2026-0315-template.
omar: Acknowledged. I'll collect artifacts and start the RCA doc. Expect initial RCA draft in ~2h.
will: I'll attach metric screenshots and p95/p99 comparisons to the RCA doc.
alex-sre: All exported logs and trace links are in the incident page.
dana-ml: Adding a note to check cache eviction thresholds — might need to evict less aggressively or bump memory limits on model-proxy.
suzanne: Thanks team. If anything regresses ping @suzanne and incident-bot will re-open. :white_check_mark:
